findings.summary: ALT5 Sigma: Witkoff named Chairman, Eric Trump joins board; $1.5B offering for WLFI token treasury strategy
findings.detail: ALT5 Sigma Corporation (ALTS) appointed Zachary Witkoff as Chairman and Eric Trump to the board of directors in August 2025. ALT5 simultaneously announced a $1.5 billion registered direct offering and concurrent private placement to initiate a 'World Liberty Financial $WLFI Treasury Strategy.' Following the financing, ALT5 holds approximately 7.5% of total WLFI token supply. ALT5 is a fintech providing blockchain-powered tokenization, trading, clearing/settlement, payment, and digital asset safekeeping. Key platforms: ALT5 Pay (crypto payment gateway for merchants) and ALT5 Prime (OTC digital asset trading). The connection between ALT5, WLFI, and Trump family board members represents another layer of the Trump family crypto enterprise, with Witkoff at the intersection.
